steps.name: Build sample fixtures
Audit extension dependencies
Adapter SDK public type contract

node extension/node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --strict --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext adapter-sdk/test/type-contract.mts
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

steps.name: Pack independent Adapter SDK artifact
steps.command:
$destination = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'release24-sdk-package'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $destination | Out-Null
$pack = npm pack ./adapter-sdk --pack-destination $destination --json
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Adapter SDK npm pack failed.' }
$package = @(($pack -join [Environment]::NewLine) | ConvertFrom-Json)
$expected = @('LICENSE', 'README.md', 'adapter-package.schema.json', 'index.d.mts', 'index.mjs', 'package.json') | Sort-Object
$actual = @($package[0].files | ForEach-Object { $_.path } | Sort-Object)
if ($package.Count -ne 1 -or $package[0].name -ne '@winforms-designer/adapter-sdk' -or $package[0].version -ne '0.1.0' -or (Compare-Object $expected $actual)) {
  throw 'Adapter SDK package identity or independent six-file payload does not match the public contract.'
}
$archive = Join-Path $destination $package[0].filename
$package[0] | Add-Member -NotePropertyName sha256 -NotePropertyValue (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $archive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
$package | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $destination 'pack.json') -Encoding utf8
$pack | Write-Output
